title: Voice/media requirement evidence proposal
interpretation: verified_local means the stated local behavior has a named regression or code inspection. Remaining full acceptance is explicitly listed; synthetic transport/control-plane evidence is never live carrier, native-listener quality, production capacity or commercial evidence.

requirements.title: Public session capability
requirements.acceptance: Visitor token is short-lived and limited to one clinic/conversation; cannot list staff or patient records.
requirements.verified_behavior: Opaque expiring caller token is scoped to a persisted clinic/call; staff JWT routes reject it.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Server-derived tenant
requirements.acceptance: Model or browser request fields cannot set tenant authority, verified identity or arbitrary outbound targets.
requirements.verified_behavior: Caller schemas reject tenant, proof and routing-authority injection; backend derives tenant and subject proof.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Contact verification
requirements.acceptance: OTP or an approved equivalent is required before sensitive existing-booking disclosure and changes.
requirements.verified_behavior: Existing-booking read/change requires a reference plus session/tenant-bound proof of the stored phone.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: OTP abuse resistance
requirements.acceptance: Challenges expire, are attempt/rate limited, session/tenant scoped and not exposed in production responses/logs.
requirements.verified_behavior: Five-minute OTP challenges remain session/tenant scoped, attempt limited and encrypted. A clinic+phone three-per-ten-minute allowance and global phone hourly allowance survive concurrent new sessions. Counter/challenge/outbox/receipt roll back atomically on receipt failure; real-mode responses do not expose the code.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Caller ID limitations
requirements.acceptance: Withheld, spoofed, recycled and family phone numbers do not imply patient identity.
requirements.verified_behavior: PBX DID selects tenant only; caller-ID never grants patient authority. A provided phone must pass explicit proof.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Prompt injection boundary
requirements.acceptance: Injected instructions cannot change scope, policy, SQL, calendar authority, price or webhook destination.
requirements.verified_behavior: The implemented conversation is a bounded server state machine; caller text cannot execute SQL, choose arbitrary tenants or overwrite price/verification facts.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Abuse quotas
requirements.acceptance: SMS flooding, repeated holds/calls and expensive outbound routes are limited without biometric profiling.
requirements.verified_behavior: Real all-channel call admission, per-call duration reservations, per-clinic+phone and global-phone OTP limits, turn/hold limits and worker capacity are bounded and tested, including independent PostgreSQL connections up to 80 admitted sessions.
remaining_acceptance: Actual supplier currency spend ceilings and approved outbound-route budgets remain deployment/operator acceptance. Duration reservation alone is not a provider cost ceiling.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Working hours and shifts
requirements.acceptance: Hours, breaks, overnight boundaries, holidays and physician absence constrain all offers and commits.
requirements.verified_behavior: Clinic/provider shifts, holiday, lead-time, horizon and duration/buffer checks constrain calendar writes; narrowing practitioner shifts cannot strand active appointments.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Call policy snapshot
requirements.acceptance: Each call pins a valid approved policy; urgent security/safety revocation supersedes the snapshot.
requirements.verified_behavior: Each call pins policy and published identity; live paused/inactive tenant, expired call, human connection and revoked partner authority override continued automation.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Approved knowledge facts
requirements.acceptance: Hours/address/parking/price/insurance/preparation entries require source, approval and effective/expiry bounds.
requirements.verified_behavior: FAQ publish supplies owner approval/source/effective/expiry metadata and voice reads its pinned snapshot.
remaining_acceptance: Clinic-specific fact accuracy and approval must be supplied by the authorized clinic; direct address configuration remains a separate approved-settings field rather than a complete fact-source record.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Expired knowledge fallback
requirements.acceptance: Expired, conflicting or unapproved facts cannot be answered as current; create staff follow-up.
requirements.verified_behavior: Expired, malformed, future-effective and unapproved matched FAQ entries route to staff.
remaining_acceptance: Conflicting multiple matching facts are not comprehensively reconciled; a dedicated conflict/freshness acceptance matrix remains necessary.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Automation modes
requirements.acceptance: Human-primary, after-hours, overflow, supervised and paused modes have explicit behavior and staff control.
requirements.verified_behavior: human_primary, after_hours, overflow, supervised, ai_primary and paused have distinct behavior. Only trusted PBX busy/no-answer events authorize overflow.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Budgets and channel caps
requirements.acceptance: Tenant limits cover concurrency, hold creation, call duration, spend and message attempts.
requirements.verified_behavior: All-channel admission reserves bounded active-call durations against monthly canonical call usage; worker capacity and hold/message attempt limits are separate.
remaining_acceptance: Configured minute and attempt caps do not yet establish a measured monetary spend ceiling across every external provider.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Recording and retention settings
requirements.acceptance: Per-purpose retention, recording off default and human alternatives are visible in understandable Persian.
requirements.verified_behavior: Persian public notice explicitly distinguishes discarded raw audio and disabled training from encrypted necessary conversation text/results. It displays the current clinic retention period after call end, scheduled cleanup, deletion/human alternatives and separate necessary booking records. Processing consent is required and the call policy snapshot records retention_days.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.
requirements.acceptance_boundary: Scheduled retention follows the configured clinic policy; no exact deletion instant or deployed legal/staffing approval is asserted. Independent purpose-specific retention administration is assessed with privacy operations evidence.

requirements.title: Tehran frozen call clock
requirements.acceptance: A timezone-aware call reference persists across retries and local midnight; naive datetimes are rejected.
requirements.verified_behavior: Aware started_at is persisted and reused for date parsing; naive reference times fail.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Jalali conversion
requirements.acceptance: Tested conversion handles year boundary, leap Esfand and weekday checks using explicit weekday conventions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Known Tehran/Jalali references, leap Esfand, Nowruz and weekday labeling pass.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Persian digit normalization
requirements.acceptance: ASCII/Persian/Arabic digits and character variants normalize without losing leading zeros.
requirements.verified_behavior: Persian/Arabic/ASCII digits and letter variants normalize without dropping phone leading zeros.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Mobile canonicalization
requirements.acceptance: Iranian mobile input is canonicalized and validated, including country prefixes and invalid lengths.
requirements.verified_behavior: Iranian mobile forms including +98/0098 normalize; malformed length and surrounding prose reject.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Optional national ID syntax
requirements.acceptance: Checksum/length validation is optional and never treated as proof of identity.
requirements.verified_behavior: Optional national-ID checksum is a syntax helper and is not used as patient proof.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Tomorrow and day-after
requirements.acceptance: فردا and پس‌فردا resolve from frozen Tehran date rather than host timezone.
requirements.verified_behavior: Tomorrow/day-after derive from the frozen Tehran call date.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Next weekday ambiguity
requirements.acceptance: سه‌شنبه هفته دیگه and شنبه‌ی هفته‌ی بعد return exact candidates and clarification when convention is ambiguous.
requirements.verified_behavior: Different next-week conventions yield exact date alternatives and explicit clarification.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Named Jalali dates
requirements.acceptance: بیستم آبان resolves only within configured year/horizon; past or ambiguous year is not silently accepted.
requirements.verified_behavior: Named Jalali dates have inferred-year confirmation and invalid/out-of-horizon rejection.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Approximate time windows
requirements.acceptance: غروب، آخر وقت، صبح، بعدازظهر map to configured ranges or clarification, never invented exact instants.
requirements.verified_behavior: Morning/evening/afternoon map to ranges, never a fabricated exact instant; actual offers are filtered by live availability.
remaining_acceptance: Time-window ranges are currently code-defined rather than configurable per clinic; آخر وقت does not have a specialized last-slot interpretation.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Colloquial clock time
requirements.acceptance: چهار و ربع، شیش و نیم and AM/PM ambiguity resolve with permitted shifts and explicit readback.
requirements.verified_behavior: Colloquial half/quarter-hour candidates remain ambiguous until period/shift disambiguation; final slot readback is explicit.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Relative month and short offset
requirements.acceptance: اول ماه بعد and نیم ساعت دیگه are handled deterministically or returned as unsupported clarification.
requirements.verified_behavior: Unsupported relative-month/short-offset phrases return date_required and clarification instead of silently choosing a date.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Horizon and availability policy
requirements.acceptance: Lead time, booking horizon, holiday, shift, duration and buffer constrain resolved candidates.
requirements.verified_behavior: Parsed dates do not bypass the calendar horizon, holidays, shifts, lead time, service duration or buffer.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Persian spoken readback
requirements.acceptance: Canonical times/dates/prices/identifiers receive deterministic natural Persian labels separate from slot IDs.
requirements.verified_behavior: Canonical slot IDs stay separate from Persian Jalali date/time labels and verified booking references.
remaining_acceptance: Fully lexical spoken prices and digit-by-digit identifiers have not been separately demonstrated across TTS providers.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Pronunciation dictionary
requirements.acceptance: Versioned provider/street/insurance vocabulary and phonetic alternatives feed supported ASR/TTS adapters.
requirements.verified_behavior: Published pronunciation version is pinned per call; written/alias hints feed STT and only meaning-preserving vowel marks feed TTS. Hidden controls reject.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Accessibility alternatives
requirements.acceptance: Repeat, slower speech, DTMF, SMS and human fallback are reachable after critical-field uncertainty.
requirements.verified_behavior: Repeat, slow speech, textual input, AudioSocket DTMF, OTP and human task/direct-phone alternatives exist.
remaining_acceptance: Real accessibility/user testing and an interactive SMS fallback channel are not established by the current OTP/notification flow.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Fourteen-day context
requirements.acceptance: Dynamic Shamsi context is an advisory display aid; it cannot authorize dates or calendar writes.
requirements.verified_behavior: Fourteen-day Shamsi helper returns labels only; all writes require signed scoped slots and fresh policy checks.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Bounded slot offers
requirements.acceptance: Conversation presents at most two actual current choices and expires stale offers.
requirements.verified_behavior: Each conversation offer batch contains at most two real slots; stale slot/policy tokens cannot be committed.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Temporary slot holds
requirements.acceptance: Holds have owner, expiry, resource interval and policy; expiration/release/limits are enforced at commit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Call-owned holds expire, release on correction/end/handoff and atomically consume only matching ownership.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Explicit caller confirmation
requirements.acceptance: Create requires current chosen slot and patient confirmation bound to the authenticated conversation.
requirements.verified_behavior: Confirmation requires a selected slot plus verified phone and explicit yes; correction prompts reconfirmation.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Idempotent booking
requirements.acceptance: Same tenant/operation/key and fingerprint returns one result; conflicting payload reuse is rejected.
requirements.verified_behavior: Turn and booking fingerprints reject mismatched request reuse; receipt replay refreshes current appointment state.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Write and read-back verification
requirements.acceptance: Confirmed state matches patient, provider, service, interval, source and durable external/internal ID.
requirements.verified_behavior: Internal calendar receipt/context commit together; booking status is re-read on replay and after TTS preparation.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Authorized cancellation
requirements.acceptance: Verified subject/staff authority and cancellation policy are checked before changing source state.
requirements.verified_behavior: Caller cancellation binds reference and verified phone; staff authorization and cancellation policy are checked by the same service.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Safe rescheduling
requirements.acceptance: Original appointment survives destination failure; atomic replace or documented compensated pending saga is used.
requirements.verified_behavior: Destination failure preserves original booking; supervised caller moves remain staff-review requests.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Family subjects
requirements.acceptance: Two relatives have distinct patient subjects, holds and confirmations; partial success is reported accurately.
requirements.verified_behavior: A two-relative conversation obtains separate patient names, proofs, holds and confirmations. Losing/replaying the first response and reconnecting does not duplicate it; expiration of the second hold leaves the first booking authoritative and explicitly reports partial success. Subsequent second confirmation creates exactly one independent appointment.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Doctor change mid-call
requirements.acceptance: Changing physician invalidates incompatible service/date/offer state without leaking prior tenant data.
requirements.verified_behavior: Explicit physician change clears incompatible slots/holds/date choices and reselects compatible service inside the same tenant.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Administrative role boundary
requirements.acceptance: Agent handles reception only and does not diagnose, prescribe, rank severity or invent insurance/preparation claims.
requirements.verified_behavior: Only fixed administrative state transitions and approved fact output exist; diagnosis/prescription requests route to staff.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: AI notice and choices
requirements.acceptance: Opening accurately discloses AI, active recording policy and available human alternative.
requirements.verified_behavior: Greeting discloses AI; pre-start notice gives disabled recording/training and an actual human alternative.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Persistent conversation state
requirements.acceptance: Intent, verified fields, policy, offers, pending operation and retries survive reconnect/restart appropriately.
requirements.verified_behavior: Encrypted call context, proof, offers, pinned policy/code versions and receipts persist in SQL. Booking and context share one transaction. Authenticated reconnect exposes current offers and authoritative family booking readback; repeated confirm IDs remain single-effect.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Turn replay protection
requirements.acceptance: Turn sequence/request IDs prevent duplicate side effects on retry or double-click.
requirements.verified_behavior: Request-hash-bound turn receipts and fenced leases prevent duplicate side effects and stale-worker writes.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: One question per turn
requirements.acceptance: Responses use concise natural Persian without hidden JSON, Markdown or stack traces in speech.
requirements.verified_behavior: Fixed Persian prompts request one next field/choice; speech only synthesizes trusted stored replies, not raw JSON or exception output.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Human request priority
requirements.acceptance: Human request is honored from any state before continuing ordinary slot filling.
requirements.verified_behavior: Human intent precedes ordinary slot-filling and is available during verification; connected humans stop all AI routes.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Urgent phrase route
requirements.acceptance: Approved potentially urgent phrases interrupt ordinary booking and invoke approved human/emergency guidance without diagnosis.
requirements.verified_behavior: Urgent phrase handling precedes booking, avoids diagnosis and queues urgent staff assistance.
remaining_acceptance: Clinical/clinic approval of the final production emergency wording and actual staffed emergency route remains external.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Low-confidence fallback
requirements.acceptance: After two failed critical-number/date attempts, use a permitted alternative or staff task.
requirements.verified_behavior: Two failed critical-field clarifications route to staff; OTP has its separately bounded challenge attempts.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Typed tool gateway
requirements.acceptance: Strict schemas, ownership, authorization, policy, timeout and idempotency checks wrap all model-proposed tools.
requirements.verified_behavior: Pydantic tool inputs, server ownership/policy checks and idempotency fence the deterministic calendar path.
remaining_acceptance: No arbitrary model-proposed tool orchestrator is enabled; a future LLM tool gateway needs its own schema/timeout conformance run.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Trusted outcome metadata
requirements.acceptance: Response metadata tracks intent, signals, policy, verified fields, pending tool and actual outcome outside speech.
requirements.verified_behavior: Structured result has state, offers, booking, handoff, capabilities and turn ID; encrypted context stores intent/proof/policy.
remaining_acceptance: A complete standardized signals/pending-tool metadata trace is not yet exposed for every provider stage.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: No invented FAQ facts
requirements.acceptance: Only current approved tenant knowledge is answerable; unknowns use honest follow-up.
requirements.verified_behavior: Answers require nonempty approved-by/source and timezone-aware effective/expiry evidence pinned to the call. Conflicting valid matches hand off; expired entries cannot override a valid current answer; equivalent answers are deduplicated. An address field without approved fact provenance is never spoken as the answer.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Bounded fallback speech
requirements.acceptance: One truthful progress acknowledgement, bounded retries and a safe exit replace endless filler.
requirements.verified_behavior: Provider calls have bounded timeouts; no speculative success, blind write retry or endless filler loop is generated.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Interruption integrity
requirements.acceptance: Barge-in clears queued speech/speculation while durable booking/payment facts remain correct.
requirements.verified_behavior: Barge-in invalidates playback generations while preserving and publishing already committed outcomes.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Disconnect recovery
requirements.acceptance: Dropped calls cancel providers, end usage, release unused holds and reconcile started writes.
requirements.verified_behavior: Call end meters once and releases holds; transport cleanup/watchdogs stop orphan processing and bound already-submitted writes.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Language fallback
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported English/Arabic/code-switching routes to an approved language path rather than fabricated fluency.
requirements.verified_behavior: Explicit English, Arabic and mixed-language requests for those languages queue a human task, record the requested language, release uncommitted holds and truthfully state that the assistant supports Persian and staff language capability still needs checking.
remaining_acceptance: Unannounced language/code-switch classification is not a comprehensively validated language detector. Actual language-qualified staff availability and pickup capacity require clinic staffing evidence.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Caller memory consent
requirements.acceptance: Cross-call memory and next-visit personalization require explicit opt-in and deletion support.
requirements.verified_behavior: Cross-call personalization is disabled: every call gets a fresh encrypted context; phone proof does not load historical conversational memory.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Prompt/config versioning
requirements.acceptance: Model, prompt, locale, policy and adapter versions attach to reproducible redacted traces.
requirements.verified_behavior: Each new call pins the application version and SHA-256 identifiers of FSM, locale, authoritative calendar and provider-adapter code. Explicit configured ASR/TTS version labels are recorded, otherwise not_recorded. Results, encrypted turn receipts and authenticated reconnect carry the same immutable tuple. There is no generative-model/prompt stage to invent.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Transport contract
requirements.acceptance: start_call/send_audio/interrupt/transfer/hangup and events have typed capability-based interfaces.
requirements.verified_behavior: Typed call/turn/registration/worker APIs and bounded transport implementations exist.
remaining_acceptance: A single formal start/send/interrupt/transfer/hangup adapter interface with a shared capability-conformance suite has not been completed.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: AudioSocket framing
requirements.acceptance: Three-byte headers handle fragmented/coalesced TCP input, UUID, DTMF, hangup and valid PCM frame types.
requirements.verified_behavior: Fragmented TCP header/payload, UUID, DTMF, hangup and malformed/truncated frame handling pass.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: PCM format correctness
requirements.acceptance: 8-kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian audio is not confused with G.711 bytes; sample rates are validated.
requirements.verified_behavior: Only explicit 16-bit aligned PCM/rates are decoded; resampling preserves duration and malformed WAV expansion rejects.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Audio pacing and buffers
requirements.acceptance: 20-ms playback pacing, bounded queues, backpressure and cancellation avoid overrun and unbounded memory.
requirements.verified_behavior: AudioSocket uses paced frames; WebRTC capture queue and pending-turn queue are bounded; stale generations cancel output.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Speech provider abstraction
requirements.acceptance: STT partial/final/keyterms, structured model tools and TTS audio/chunks have comparable contracts.
requirements.verified_behavior: Final-transcript STT/keyterms and complete WAV TTS adapters share guarded contracts.
remaining_acceptance: Partial-transcript streaming, chunked TTS and structured model tool-stream parity are not implemented as a common realtime provider contract.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Provider timeouts and breaker
requirements.acceptance: Timeouts, rate limits, circuit-breaker states and permitted fallback are measured and logged.
requirements.verified_behavior: Provider timeouts/breaker cooldown and unknown non-idempotent outcome behavior have local regression evidence.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Fallback eligibility
requirements.acceptance: Fallback cannot silently transmit data to a region/provider lacking tenant approval.
requirements.verified_behavior: Provider approval/host allowlist is mandatory; there is no automatic alternate-processor fallback that bypasses approval.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Browser audio lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: User-initiated microphone permission, connected state, stop, reconnect and cleanup are accurately represented.
requirements.verified_behavior: Backend expiry, safe stop and actual loopback audio path are verified.
remaining_acceptance: Merge frontend microphone/stop/reconnect test evidence; mobile OS/background behavior is a separate external matrix.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: WebRTC session isolation
requirements.acceptance: Production WebRTC route has scoped room tokens, HTTPS/TURN configuration and per-session privacy.
requirements.verified_behavior: Scoped room tokens, one registration per call, worker lease fencing and signed staff join are verified locally.
remaining_acceptance: Production public HTTPS, ICE/TURN/NAT and cross-device isolation need deployment acceptance; one loopback call is insufficient.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Voice activity and endpointing
requirements.acceptance: Turn endpointing permits slow digits/hesitant speakers and handles silence/noise without hallucinated actions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Energy endpointing avoids transcribing pure silence, supports pre-roll/barge-in and bounds long utterances.
remaining_acceptance: Real hesitant/slow-digit/noisy Persian caller slices need blinded acoustic validation.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Cached licensed phrases
requirements.acceptance: Stable audio cache is versioned by voice/policy/text; cache-hit telemetry and interruption work.
requirements.verified_behavior: Only exact static greeting is cacheable by tenant/policy/voice/text/slow key; hits avoid provider-character billing and dynamic readbacks are uncached.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Latency telemetry
requirements.acceptance: Measure end-of-turn to first audible output and STT/model/tool/TTS/transfer subspans separately.
requirements.verified_behavior: VoiceTurn.latency_ms measures the synchronous conversation/tool transaction. Root added durable STT/TTS provider and verified-human-join spans. The recorded native RTC smoke proves one synthetic audio path, while the control-plane load report intentionally excludes acoustic latency.
remaining_acceptance: Root latency API/first-received-PCM evidence should be merged separately. No acoustic P50/P95/P99 or actual paid-network end-of-turn-to-first-audible SLO is inferred from handler timing.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Call quotas and admission
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent sessions, per-call time/spend, tenant budgets and overload fallback are enforced.
requirements.verified_behavior: Serialized mixed-channel admission, maximum 30-minute call reservations, one-minute budget contention, absolute media deadlines and eight-room worker assignment are locally verified, including six isolated PostgreSQL load levels.
remaining_acceptance: Actual supplier currency spend enforcement is not established by minute reservations or this synthetic benchmark. Paid provider budgets and approved financial caps remain deployment acceptance.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: DID and physician routing
requirements.acceptance: DID-first routing and explicit physician/name/specialty disambiguation never cross tenant permissions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Trusted DID map selects tenant and doctor selection is limited to that tenant; browser overflow claims reject.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Handoff transport truth
requirements.acceptance: Requested/ringing/accepted/connected/failed states follow real transport events; a task is not a connected call.
requirements.verified_behavior: Task/QUEUED is distinct from CONNECTED; only verified authorized participant events establish connection, and AI then stops.
remaining_acceptance: Full PSTN requested/ringing/accepted/failed warm-transfer state and real carrier fallback require external tests.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: No orphan provider session
requirements.acceptance: Teardown/cancellation releases audio/model handles and finalizes usage exactly once.
requirements.verified_behavior: End is idempotent, unused holds release and stale media workers cannot terminate a successor; local watchdog cleanup is bounded.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: SIP deploy configuration
requirements.acceptance: Carrier templates avoid real credentials/public unsafe defaults and document ACL/codecs/ports/DTMF/TLS options.

requirements.title: Synthetic capacity harness
requirements.acceptance: Load tooling exercises 4/8 then 10/20/50/80 sessions and reports limits without claiming real carrier capacity.
requirements.verified_behavior: The reproducible explicitly acknowledged harness exercises real new_session/media_rooms/end_session handlers over independent PostgreSQL connections at 4/8/10/20/50/80 admitted sessions. Each level rejects two excess calls, enforces duration reservations and an eight-room worker bound under competing polls, verifies one-minute budget contention and idempotent finalization. Both actual runs passed; the latest records component hashes and verifies temporary schema removal.
remaining_acceptance: Scope boundary: direct typed control handlers, not HTTP transport, audio/GPU throughput, carrier channels, mobile devices, public network/TLS/TURN or a paid-capacity SLO.
requirements.scope: Voice/media assessment; merge overlapping frontend, operations, deployment and commercial evidence separately.

requirements.title: Published deposit policy
requirements.acceptance: Deposits are disabled until amount, currency, expiry, cancellation and refund terms are published.
requirements.verified_behavior: For voice deposit bookings the clinic-published amount, TOMAN currency, hold limit and deposit/cancellation/refund terms are spoken before explicit yes. Changed policy/version/amount triggers fresh confirmation with no appointment. Core receives the exact accepted version and pins it. Long terms hand off rather than silently truncate speech. Synthetic tests use real-mode enforcement with an approved synthetic merchant and never call a provider. CONFIRM repeat responses also expose the same pinned terms; the final two-case rerun verifies this response contract.
requirements.scope: Voice consent evidence only; merge payment-policy publication, merchant/account ownership and supplier verification evidence from the payments owner.

livekit.boundary: Last nonzero synthetic input SDK frame to first nonzero reply PCM received; single loopback observation, not physical speaker latency or an SLO distribution.

audiosocket.boundary: Real loopback TCP/PCM plus durable turn and cleanup; no carrier, physical PBX, NAT or acoustic capacity claim.
